title: Bekal fest scam: CPM-led society registered using forged lease deed; lakhs in secret account unaudited
content: Kasaragod: Right from its first edition in 2022-2023, the Tourism Department's Bekal International Beach Fest, intended to promote Kasaragod as a tourist destination, has been dogged by allegations of corruption, financial irregularities and lack of transparency. So far, the financial decisions surrounding the festival were largely presented as collective ones. But now, Youth League Kasaragod district treasurer Adv T K Haseeb has released 18 of over 30 documents he got through RTI that put C H Kunhambu, former CPM MLA from Udma, in the middle of the alleged financial scam. The documents include a Tourism Department inspection report that found serious financial irregularities in the functioning of the Kunhambu-led organising committee. The report found that the first edition did not account for 45 lakh received from three sources: 10 lakh each from Bank of Baroda and Kasaragod City Gold, and 25 lakh under the event-management contract. Yet, at Kunhambu's request, Bekal Resorts Development Corporation (BRDC), headed by Shijin P, gave 50 lakh to the organising committee to cover a purported 86-lakh loss suffered in the second edition. The money was given despite opposition from the corporation's finance officer, as shown by documents. "I have been after these documents for a long time but got them only after the change in government. The LDF government sat on its own inquiry report without any action. Now we are demanding a vigilance probe into each of these irregularities," said Adv Haseeb. Forgery at the core Kunhambu is accused of forging a lease agreement to register a society to organise the first edition of Bekal International Beach Fest from December 24, 2022 to January 2, 2023. When the State GST Department found out that the building owners did not sign the lease agreements submitted by Bekal Tourism Promotion Society, it cancelled the society's registration, said Adv Haseeb. Onmanorama reached out to the owners of the building, Ramla Basheer and her husband P M Abdul Basheer. Their son-in-law Jouhar said Basheer was recuperating after heart surgery. But after checking with them, Jouhar said the "lease agreements were forged". Six of the seven members of Bekal Tourism Promotion Society, headed by Kunhambu, were CPM leaders. The seventh member and treasurer of the society was Shijn P, managing director of Bekal Resorts Development Corporation (BRDC), a public sector undertaking set up to develop the coastal region of Bekal. Until Adv Haseeb released the documents, Kunhambu had always maintained that the Bekal fest was organised by an all-party people's organising committee. ​The Bekal Tourism Promotion Society opened a bank account with Punjab National Bank's branch in Pallikkara, and Bekal International Beach Fest Sangadaka Samithi (organising committee) opened a bank account with the CPM-controlled Pallikkere Service Cooperative Bank. Both accounts received sponsorship money and revenue generated by the festival. "The only difference is the society's bank account with Punjab National Bank was till now a secret account never subjected to auditing and inspection by the Department of Tourism," said Adv Haseeb. "The fact is, when the government accepted BRDC's proposal for the Bekal beach fest on September 28, 2022, it asked the corporation to anchor the festival. Neither the BRDC board nor the government order authorised an organising committee headed by Kunhambu or the Bekal Tourism Promotion Society to take charge of the event's finances," he said. According to the RTI documents, Kunhambu and Shijin registered Bekal Tourism Promotion Society on November 21, 2022, two months after the LDF government gave BRDC the green signal to organise the Bekal fest. Shijin was a member of the personal staff team of the then Tourism Minister P A Mohamed Riyas before he was made the managing director of BRDC. DYFI leader K Manikandan, the then Kanhangad Block Panchayat president, was made the society's secretary...
